sections.title: Create Payment
sections.content: Create a new payment request for your customers. The payment will be valid for 15 minutes by default.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to receive payment in (BTC, ETH, USDT, etc.)

parameters.name: redirect_url
parameters.description: URL to redirect user after payment

languages.python:
import requests
import json

headers = {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer your_api_key_here',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}

data = {
    'amount': 100.50,
    'currency': 'USDT',
    'order_id': 'order_123456'
}

response = requests.post('https://api.bitmopay.com/api/v1/payments', 
                        headers=headers, 
                        data=json.dumps(data))
languages.php:
<?php
$headers = [
    'Authorization: Bearer your_api_key_here',
    'Content-Type: application/json'
];

$data = [
    'amount' => 100.50,
    'currency' => 'USDT',
    'order_id' => 'order_123456'
];

$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, 'https://api.bitmopay.com/api/v1/payments');
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, 1);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($data));
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
